editorial: You step into a gothic love story where ghosts are only part of the danger. Edith, an aspiring writer, loses her father and falls for the charming Thomas Sharpe, who brings her to his crumbling family home. There, his sister Lucille watches every move, and the house itself seems alive with secrets. The mood is rich, romantic, and eerie, with beautiful costumes and sets that make every room feel like a character. The acting is strong, especially Jessica Chastain’s intense Lucille, and the visuals are gorgeous from start to finish. The downside is the slow pace and a story you may guess early, so it is more spooky drama than pure horror. If you enjoy gothic romance, dark family secrets, and stunning design, give it a try. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final act, Edith learns Thomas and Lucille are siblings who have killed before, including her father, to protect their secrets and fortune. Thomas begins to care for Edith and turns against Lucille, who stabs him. Edith fights Lucille in the snow, killing her with a shovel. Thomas dies holding Edith, and she survives, finally free of the house and its ghosts.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves gothic romance, dark family secrets, and beautiful horror visuals.
